scope: One qualified off/on pair for N35 and N40; no performance-based selection or rerun

performance.throughput_definition: All successful input tokens, including reused prefix tokens, divided by AISBench Benchmark Duration.

sources.definition: L2 remains L2 after early prefetch into L1. Physical block-layer shards are converted to full-layer token equivalents.
sources.limitation: OFF only identifies aggregate L1/L2 sources; per-request source classes are not inferred.

ordinary_waiting_unattributed.label: 普通排队，具体调度约束未归因

queue.counting: State held from each saved snapshot until the next; averages use nonempty-queue time. Causes are mutually exclusive observed states/last decisions, not proof of continuous physical bottlenecks. waiting_ready in schema 2 means the ordinary queue, not Early READY.
queue.limitations: No unique-request count or exact per-request waiting latency is inferred from aggregate snapshots. Token budget, sequence limit and head-of-line effects remain unattributed unless explicitly observed.
